categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main segments: semiconductor packaging equipment and molds, and plastic extrusion molding molds, extrusion molding devices, and downstream equipment. It focuses on the R&D, design, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment tailored for semiconductor packaging and plastic extrusion molding industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include resin handling technology for semiconductor chip packaging, dynamic PID pressure control, multi-cavity high-speed extrusion molding, co-extrusion molding, and a proprietary PowerLaw non-Newtonian fluid model based on Weissenberg-Robinowitsch correction. The company also develops advanced molding and cutting technologies, automated packaging systems, and real-time injection pressure monitoring for semiconductor packaging equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading semiconductor packaging companies in China such as Tongfu Microelectronics, Huatian Technology, and Changdian Technology. The plastic extrusion molding products serve global customers in over 40 countries, including high-end markets in Europe and North America, primarily targeting plastic window and door profile manufacturers and other plastic profile producers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with a significant domestic market presence in semiconductor packaging equipment. Its plastic extrusion molding equipment has a broad international footprint, exporting to more than 40 countries worldwide, with a focus on Europe and North America for high-end markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing intelligent manufacturing equipment and molds used by downstream semiconductor packaging and plastic extrusion profile manufacturers. It procures raw materials and components from upstream suppliers and sells finished equipment to downstream customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include increasing domestic production and import substitution in semiconductor packaging equipment, advancing R&D in wafer-level and panel-level advanced packaging technologies, and expanding global market share in plastic extrusion molding equipment. The company emphasizes continuous innovation, technology upgrades, and collaboration with industry leaders and academic institutions to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized intelligent manufacturing equipment and molds to semiconductor packaging and plastic extrusion molding enterprises. The company employs a direct sales model, signing contracts directly with customers and delivering products with installation and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In semiconductor packaging equipment, the company competes with international giants like TOWA, YAMADA, ASM Pacific, BESI, and DISCO, holding a competitive position among domestic suppliers. In plastic extrusion molding equipment, it is a leading domestic player with strong international competitiveness, especially in high-end European and North American markets, competing with companies like Austria's EXELLIQ.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 268.2 million, a 35.48% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 64 million, up 22.10%. Total assets reached RMB 1.22 billion, growing 6.72% from the previous year. The company has shown steady growth driven by market recovery in semiconductor packaging and sustained demand in extrusion molding equipment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary core technologies, high automation and intelligent control in its equipment, and strong customization capabilities. It offers high-quality, reliable semiconductor packaging equipment with narrowing gaps to international brands and leads in plastic extrusion molding technology with advanced design software and precision manufacturing, providing customers with efficient, stable, and innovative production solutions.
